a2-16.title: Communicative Challenge: What Does He Look Like?
a2-16.scenario: Károly asks Meg what her neighbour Tamás looks like. He has a beard and glasses, and his hair is black.
a2-16.prompt: Describe your neighbour to Károly: he has a beard and wears glasses, and his hair is black.
cues: Say he has a beard and wears glasses
Say what colour his hair is
a2-16.target: A szomszédom szakállas és szemüveges. Fekete haja van.
a2-16.english: My neighbour has a beard and wears glasses. He has black hair.
a2-16.canDo: I can describe someone's hair and other features.

a2-17.title: Communicative Challenge: A Good Colleague
a2-17.scenario: Károly asks Meg what her new colleague is like. She is smart, hardworking and patient, but a little serious.
a2-17.prompt: Tell Károly what your colleague is like: she is smart, hardworking and patient, but serious.
cues: Say she is smart and hardworking
Say she is patient but serious
a2-17.target: A kollégám okos és szorgalmas. Türelmes, de komoly.
a2-17.english: My colleague is smart and hardworking. She is patient, but serious.
a2-17.canDo: I can describe someone's personality with more detail.

a2-18.title: Communicative Challenge: Different People
a2-18.scenario: Károly asks whether Meg's colleague and her neighbour are alike. They are very different: the colleague is serious, the neighbour is funny.
a2-18.prompt: Tell Károly that your colleague and your neighbour are very different, and say how.
cues: Say the two people are very different
Say which one is serious and which one is funny
a2-18.target: A kollégám és a szomszédom nagyon különbözőek. A kollégám komoly, a szomszédom vicces.
a2-18.english: My colleague and my neighbour are very different. My colleague is serious, my neighbour is funny.
a2-18.canDo: I can say two people or things are similar or different.

a2-19.title: Communicative Challenge: Someone Who Helps
a2-19.scenario: Károly asks Meg who she knows at work and in the building. You (Meg) have a colleague who is hardworking and friendly, and you know a neighbour who is very funny.
a2-19.prompt: Tell Károly about a colleague who is hardworking and friendly, and a neighbour who is very funny.
cues: Describe your colleague with a who-clause
Say you know a funny neighbour
a2-19.target: Van egy kollégám, aki szorgalmas és barátságos. Ismerek egy szomszédot, aki nagyon vicces.
a2-19.english: I have a colleague who is hardworking and friendly. I know a neighbour who is very funny.
a2-19.canDo: I can describe someone using a whole clause with aki.

a2-20.title: Communicative Challenge: Petra and Tamás
a2-20.scenario: Károly asks Meg about two new people in her life: her colleague Petra and her neighbour Tamás.
a2-20.prompt: Introduce Petra and Tamás to Károly: Petra is a hardworking, friendly colleague, and Tamás is a bearded neighbour.
cues: Say who Petra is and what she is like
Say who Tamás is and what he looks like
a2-20.target: Petra a kolléganőm, aki nagyon szorgalmas és barátságos. Tamás a szomszédom, aki szakállas.
a2-20.english: Petra is my colleague, who is very hardworking and friendly. Tamás is my neighbour, who has a beard.
a2-20.canDo: I can give a full description of a new person in my life.

a2-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Comparing People
a2-20-consolidation.scenario: Károly wants to know more about Tamás. He wears glasses and has a beard, and he is as friendly as Meg's colleague Petra.
a2-20-consolidation.prompt: Describe Tamás to Károly: what he looks like, and that he is as friendly as Petra.
cues: Say he wears glasses and has a beard
Compare how friendly he is with Petra
a2-20-consolidation.target: A szomszédom szemüveges és szakállas, és olyan barátságos, mint a kolléganőm.
a2-20-consolidation.english: My neighbour wears glasses and has a beard, and he is as friendly as my colleague.
a2-20-consolidation.canDo: I can describe someone's appearance and personality in detail.
